description: The host declares Screenshot locales uk, en, de, but docusaurus.config has only uk and en: app-explorer stops at Step 0, names de as a locale it can't place, asks instead of guessing a folder, and writes nothing.
setup:
printf 'OPERATOR_BASE_URL=https://test.example.com
OPERATOR_USERNAME=tester
OPERATOR_PASSWORD=secret
' > .env && printf '.env
' >> .gitignore && printf '%s
' '- **Admin UI:** playwright' '- **API test collection:** .sources/demo.postman_collection.json' '- **API collection runner:** newman' >> CLAUDE.md && mkdir -p .sources portal/transactions/.sources && printf '{"info":{"name":"demo"},"item":[]}
' > .sources/demo.postman_collection.json && printf '{"section":"portal/transactions","verdict":"needs-revision","pages":["transactions.md"]}
' > portal/transactions/.sources/section-readiness.json && printf '%s
' '- **Screenshot locales:** `uk, en, de`' '- **Locale switch:** `url-prefix uk=/, en=/en/, de=/de/`' >> CLAUDE.md && git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'

assertions.name: names de as the locale that can't be placed
